text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Restrict the recall denominator to confirmed defects**

The repository's adjudication models include outcomes that do not represent valid defects, such as `false_positive`, `out_of_scope`, `ronda_better`, and `duplicate` (`src/quality/miss-record.ts:22-28` and `src/cli/recall-benchmark.ts:60-65`), but this denominator includes every “adjudicated external finding.” An implementation can therefore count a rejected or duplicate finding as a miss under the rule below, depressing recall even though Ronda correctly omitted it. Define which terminal outcomes enter the denominator and require duplicate adjudications to collapse to one confirmed defect.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
rationale: Author fixed it: Fixed in 01cbdde. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
